annotations.title: Get a Pokémon's checks and counters

description: List the Pokémon that most reliably beat the given Pokémon on the ladder, ranked by Smogon's checks-and-counters score. The data records one-on-one outcomes (a knockout or a forced switch), so in doubles treat it as a rough signal. Pokémon with few recorded matchups have no data.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1–30). Defaults to 10

pokemon.description: Pokémon name in English. Mega Evolutions are tracked separately, e.g. "Charizard-Mega-Y"

name: get_checks_and_counters

score.description: (win rate − 4 × standard deviation) × 100; higher is stronger

winRatePercent.description: Share of encounters it won by knockout or forced switch

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

title: Get a Pokémon's checks and counters
